test_size_dataframe: test the DataFrame.size property returns the total number of elements for various data and index configurations
test_size_empty_dataframe: test that DataFrame.size returns 0 for an empty DataFrame
test_size_with_nan_values: test that DataFrame.size counts rows including those with NaN values
test_size_with_custom_index: test that DataFrame.size returns correct count when a custom index is provided
verify_size_is_int: verify that DataFrame.size always returns an integer type
